relationships.subject: lacrimal gland excision
relationships.evidence_quote: Lacrimal gland excision increased the number of ATF3-positive neurons by more than 2-fold

key_findings: Lacrimal gland excision caused corneal denervation followed by reinnervation (faster in males) and increased ATF3 in corneal neurons.
CGRP and TRPV1 expression increased in IB4-positive corneal afferents after LGE, suggesting a phenotypic switch.
